body:
For this story I will use ML for my name and DC for my friend. It was a saturday night and I had prepared about 5 1/2 inches of san pedro for me to eat and I had given DC about a 1 ft. But had only ingested about 3 inches . So Me my brother and DC went to a costume party in our city . We show up at the party no one is there yet. May I mention I had eaten all my mescaline about 2 or 3 hours proir to the party.
Anyways the mescal had juss started to take effect I kept feeling the cool breeze of the wind down to my bones but it was not making me cold at all. I became warm after every breath. A few minutes pass probably about 45 minutes or around there the party is starting to crack a bunch of my homies come through and I am feeling great no visuals yet just a nice tingly body sensation. The dj shows up and the music starts playing lights flashing now thing feel different. I was standing thinking to myself and I start to wonder how long I've been there my vision begins to get a bit blurry and distorted. As I look around I begin to notice the trees are starting to look like animated objects almost as if they were enlarged plants not trees but it made sense to me in some weird way that it was a living life force just like me. I look at the grass and start to see patches of grass form patters and start to warp my body feels as if it is being warped and bended not in a painful way but more of a euphoric way.
I start to notice that I can understand what people are thinking through theyre actions almost like I can figure out a question without even asking them or speaking to them it was an overall understanding for every living thing around me. I start to get freaked out abit because it is starting to get intense my vision becomes completely distorted and suddenly my friend DC starts talking to me... When I look at him he appears to be so close to me that it seems like I'm looking through a magnifying glass everything seemed so bigg hahaha it was fantastic overall the 7 star san pedro I ate was pretty good and I can definatly consider this a good experience and by the way this is about my 5th time using mescaline.
